text:
Alex W: FYI found a weird auth path after the key rotate — embeddings calls are being accepted with a token that only has 'chat' scope.
Priya S: whoa, can you paste the audit id / a log snippet?
Alex W: audit_id=2026-03-18T12:34:56Z, auth_check passed, scope=chat, requested=embeddings, status=200
Ben L: is this hitting the per-route enforcer or falling back to legacy route handling?
Alex W: looks like route matcher returned the legacy embeddings handler and that path does a looser check. quick snippet I found:
```
AuthService.validate(token, route) {
  if (route.enableLegacyFallback) return true  // <-- legacy bypass
  return checkScopes(token, route.requiredScopes)
}
```
Priya S: that fallback was supposed to be removed during the RBAC refactor. when did the rotate happen for that customer?
Simone R: customer rotation at 03:00 UTC, control-plane rolled key tags at ~03:02. Possible cache invalidation race between route config and auth-cache TTL.
Alex W: repro steps: rotate key A -> B, immediately call embeddings with token B at high qps, intermittent 200s. can reproduce reliably in a tight loop.
Ben L: ack. temp mitigations: 1) disable legacy fallback flag via config, 2) gate on model-level scope in gateway before route dispatch.
Simone R: I'll flip the config to disable fallback now and push a short-term gateway rule to enforce model-type scopes.
sec-bot: Automated alert: invalid-scope-usage detected (event=9f3a), applied blocking rule to token B for 5m.
Priya S: long term we need: a) ensure per-route scope check is canonical and authoritative, b) add tests to prevent fallback regressions, c) update rotation checklist to flush auth caches/tags synchronously.
Alex W: affected token count observed = 3, affected client_ids = ["cli-123","cli-455","cli-789"]. No obvious data-exfil logs so far.
Ben L: I'll open a small PR to remove the fallback and add unit+integration tests for embeddings vs chat scope enforcement. https://git/repo/pull/456
Priya S: we also need to capture a timeline and notify compliance. Simone, can you take incident owner?
Simone R: taking. I'll run the repro, confirm mitigation, and post timelines + postmortem checklist here within the hour. Monitoring dashboards up for embeddings error/latency.
Alex W: thanks — I'll attach the full log dump and reproduce script in the ticket.
Priya S: update: please include key rotation timestamps and KMS-change events for forensic.
Simone R: will do. ping me if you see any more tokens accepted that shouldn't be. :thumbsup:
